description: Transfers the policy circuits' list rules admit or refuse. Each case carries the table rows and inline limits as ring-policy-table.json does, the eight source slots, the records of the ring's own and of the curator registry by member, the sender member and every UTXO output's owner, asset and amount. A subject reads list i + 1 from the curator record when source slot i names a registry field, else from its own record, an absent member reads zero. A rule holds when the subject is on any list of its present set or off any list of its absent set. A zero owner carries no owner obligation. A scalar guard exempts an owner's or an asset's output total at or below the threshold, on an owner rule every output carries one asset. An asset guard needs an inline limit for each live owner's output asset and exempts the owner's total of that asset within it. The outcome is pass, or the first refusal in table order then output order, a mixed asset refusal first. Produced by custom-rings/policy/tests/policy_rules_vector.rs.
